section.codeblock:
Install the Application Install the application on your Windows workstation. Installation install setup Windows

Before you begin, ensure you have:

  • Administrator access to the workstation
  • At least 2 GB of available disk space
  • The installation file downloaded from the support portal

This procedure installs the desktop application and configures it for first use. The installation typically takes 5–10 minutes.

 Double-click the installer file. The installation wizard opens. Click Next to accept the default installation location. To change the installation location, click Browse and select a different folder. Select the components you want to install.
  • Core Application: Required
  • Documentation: Recommended
  • Developer Tools: Optional
 Click Install. The installation progress bar appears. Wait for installation to complete. Click Finish.

The application is installed and ready to use. A shortcut appears on your desktop.

After installation, configure your user preferences. See Configure User Preferences.
